calls.title: UX Review for Event Forwarder Setup
calls.summary: The meeting centered on the development of an event forwarding feature, utilizing BigQuery as the primary data warehouse while Snowflake integration awaits cross-cloud enablement. The team discussed simplifying the event forwarder setup by separating it from data source creation to enhance clarity and error handling. Access controls and attribute management were highlighted, including the locking of data types and names during forwarding to maintain schema integrity. User experience improvements are planned to streamline workflows and clarify limitations. The feature will initially roll out as enterprise-only, requiring account manager contact, with plans for future self-service capabilities. Technical discussions emphasized connection testing and schema evolution.
calls.keywords: Event Forwarder, BigQuery, Data Warehouse, UX Design, Attribute Editing, Enterprise Feature

calls.title: UX Review for Event Forwarder Setup
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the development of the event forwarder feature, emphasizing the importance of enhancing user experience through a clear setup process for sending event data to BigQuery data warehouses. Key decisions included separating event forwarder setup from data source creation to streamline onboarding and improve error handling. Error validation features were outlined to prevent data collisions by ensuring existing table names trigger errors, thereby maintaining data integrity. A phased rollout strategy was established, initially restricting access to Enterprise users and requiring account manager involvement to ensure proper onboarding. Additionally, significant UI enhancements are planned to simplify workflows, with a focus on clarity regarding event forwarder status and controls for pausing and resuming sync operations.
calls.keywords: Event Forwarder, BigQuery, Data Source, UX/UI Design, Enterprise Feature, Attribute Management
